messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT RWINF-504 resolved and mitigation applied. Please schedule a post-incident review (PIR) within 7 days and add any follow-up action items. https://redwood.internal/incidents/RWINF-504 :white_check_mark:
Elaine G: thanks — can someone take facilitator for the PIR? prefer Fri morning PT.
Samir: I can do facil if needed, but I have a customer call Fri 10am PT. available before that.
Priya: I can attend and will share customer timeline notes. timezone: IST (UTC+5:30) so mornings PT are evening for me.
Mikkel: happy to co-facilitate with Samir if that helps, I can run the agenda and take notes.
Elaine G: ok proposal: Samir facil, Mikkel co-facil. If Samir still needs the 10am slot, we can do 8:30am PT (16:00 UTC). Does that work?
Samir: 8:30am PT works for me. I'll take facilitator.
Priya: that slot is 10pm for me — painful but doable. can we record?
Elaine G: yes will record and publish minutes. please add customer-facing folks: @support-bot to pull CS/AM rep.
support-bot: pulled: @Jules (CS) and @Hannah (AM) invited to the draft invite.
Samir: I'll make the calendar invite once we lock time. can someone add a short pre-read list?
Mikkel: Suggested pre-read (put in invite or GH):
```
- Incident timeline (ops doc)
- Root-cause hypotheses + logs (brief)
- Mitigations taken and follow-up tasks (owner + ETA)
- Customer impact summary + any comms sent
- Open questions for engineering + product
```
Elaine G: perfect. Priya can you add the customer impact summary to the pre-read?
Priya: on it, will paste short bullets and link to the thread.
Samir: invite created: calendar link https://calendar.redwood/meeting/abc123 — added pre-read placeholder and recording enabled. action owners: I'll add GH-issues for each follow-up.
Elaine G: action items to assign during PIR: rollback playbook check, KV cache validation, alert threshold tuning. we should also decide if we need a short-runbook update.
Mikkel: noted. I can own the runbook update action.
Samir: GH issue GH-789 created for follow-ups, will assign owners and due dates after the meeting.
Elaine G: thanks all. final checklist before PIR: confirm invite + pre-read by EOD tomorrow, confirm CS/AM attendance, ensure recording + transcript. :thumbsup:
Priya: confirmed — will finish pre-read by EOD.
Samir: will ping again at +24h before meeting to confirm.
Elaine G: closing thread — see calendar.
